item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of prompts that ask the same thing: is this thought accurate, and does it serve you? Notice when you're projecting or mind reading, because that's a story, not a fact. Treat the past as something you can reinterpret, not something that defines you. Perspective is a choice you make repeatedly. Action: at midday, pause for one minute and rewrite one negative thought into something accurate and kind.
